parameters.content:
## Draft-only intake review
Accepts { inquiries: [...], existing_contacts: [...] }. No credentials, schedules, webhook, database writes or send nodes. Returns every source record, duplicate candidates and draft text. Match candidates require review; never auto-merge. Output is not a durable master tracker. Use an authenticated staging writer only after its separate implementation and tests.
